lead: Mayawati has built a public profile as an Indian politician, born on 15 January 1956 in New Delhi.
As of 2026, she is 70 years old, and her birth date places her under the Capricorn sign.
She has held the office of Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh and member of Rajya Sabha.
The sections that follow break down Mayawati's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Mayawati — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Mayawati was born on 15 January 1956 in New Delhi, and holds Indian nationality.
She studied at University of Delhi, Chaudhary Charan Singh University and Faculty of Law.

sections.heading: Mayawati — Career and Professional Work
paras: Mayawati works primarily as a politician.

She has held the following offices: Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh (1995–1995), member of Rajya Sabha (2012–2017), Member of the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly, Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh (2007–2012), Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh (2002–2003) and Member of the 13th Lok Sabha. She is affiliated with Bahujan Samaj Party.
